image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), standing on snowy ground mixed with dark soil and twigs. The bird exhibits non-breeding or female plumage characteristics: brownish-grey head and upperparts, bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, and a white belly. It has a short, conical, yellowish-grey bill with a dark tip. The wings show distinct black feathers with white bars. The legs are pinkish-brown and slender.
